source_note: Marathon (module 4 v2). base/invoicekit (invoicekit, plain Node, `npm test`), 25 dependent requests in 5 groups of 5 sent one per call in order (fixtures/marathon/requests.json); house rules stated once in request 1, six decisions stated once in later requests; hidden tests after every call (each request plus every earlier one, under two time zones). Unit: a request; kept = passed right after its call and still passing at the end. With: a new session at each group boundary (what /clear amounts to in headless runs); the repo carries over, the chat does not. Without: one session for all 25 requests.
